canonical_project: SLT Colombo Cable Landing Station (SMW4 / Dhiraagu-SLT)
notes: Cable/critical infrastructure: Submarine Networks lists SLT Colombo CLS (SMW4 and Dhiraagu-SLT) as one of five Sri Lanka cable landing stations connected to the SLT Welikada international backhaul hub. Counted as cable/critical facility, not commercial datacenter; no colocation service source.
